name: Eclife 48" Double Sink Bathroom Vanity with Integrated Sink Top and Faucet, Ample Storage, Eco-Friendly Protective Coating
sub: Sage Green · Freestanding · SMC Integrated Double Sink Top · 33.5" H
features: Double Sink Convenience: The 48" width with two basins is perfect for couples or families, optimizing morning routines.
Eco-Friendly Protective Coating: The waterproof paint finish defends against moisture and simplifies cleaning.
Expansive and Quiet Storage: Multiple low-noise drawers provide plenty of space for organized storage.
Durable Top: The sturdy surface is built to withstand daily use while maintaining its appearance.
Ready to Install: Pre-drilled holes and included instructions make setup quick and uncomplicated.
desc: Ideal for shared or master bathrooms, the Eclife 48" double sink vanity delivers convenience and ample storage. The expansive Integrated Sink top includes two sinks and two faucets. The cabinet is protected by an eco-friendly waterproof paint that effectively fights off humidity and stains, ensuring easy maintenance. The drawers are designed for quiet, smooth operation, offering extensive storage solutions. Transform your bathroom into a more efficient and welcoming space with this versatile vanity.
specs: Waterproof paint finish defends against moisture and simplifies cleaning.

sub: White Marble Top · Brass Hardware · Wainscoting Style

Built on a solid wood frame and finished for daily moisture, it is designed to anchor a primary bath for years to come.
